_evidence: Overlay for 0x0043c7d2 (compose LAST; esi uses car_0043c677+car_0043c7d2). Gates on the car's segment pointer pos = [esi+0x1c] (records 0..25): 'cmp pos,[0x891500]; jae exit' (on the lap, not in the pit lane) and [0x866f00]-0xf0a0 <= pos < [0x866f00]-0x44c0 (between 175 and 50 records before the pit-entry record). The family layouts draw [0x866f00] as records 0..26, so pos >= [0x866f00]-0x44c0 always exited; on a real track the pit entry lies hundreds of records after most positions. Domain: [0x866f00] a record pointer 30..210 of the 0x8943a0 array (only compared here and in 0x43c608, whose 16-record walk 'add edi,0x1600; cmp edi,[0x866f00]; jb' reads words +0xca/+0x7a of every 16th record up to it: records past the 26 varied ones are image zeros, +0xca clamps to 0x780 and +0x7a = 0 indexes entry 0, no fault), [0x891500] the pit start 0..40 (above and below pos; 0x43c677 divides only when [0x891500] <= pos < [0x866f08], so the divisor stays positive, and 0x43c6fb's divisor is the constant 0x160), dword 0x63b830 (frame/phase counter added to car byte +0x202, 'test 0x1f') from multiples of 32 and others. The team-mate found by 0x43b974 (a car of the global array) is then tested: byte +0x71 bit 7 (0x66ff61), +0x1c (0x66ff0c: a segment record 0..25, compared with [0x891500] and differenced with pos), +0x230 bit 7 (0x670120), and through 0x43c75b its +0xfd (0x66ffed, clamped to 10 by 0x43c6fb): all plain draws. Byte 0x7c2e75 ('cmp 0; jne' before the 0x418fd0 call) draws 0/0/1/0xff. The team-mates' segment pointers also take a few far records (260, 300, 400: inside .data, image zeros past the varied 26) (beyond the pit start, the +0x230 test path); their readers only compare them, walk to [0x866f00] (exits at once when beyond it) or divide by the constant 0x160.
